Subject: Post-discovery: choose integration path & confirm technical walkthrough

Hi Samira / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: accelerate a POC to validate low-latency on-prem inference for a subset of sensitive patient workloads.
- Key constraints: max 50ms median latency target for short prompts, audit logs retained for 90 days, and SSO/KMS integration.
- Stakeholders to include: CTO (Daniel), Head of ML (TBD), and Security (Owen).

Next steps: pick which type of follow-up makes the most sense and a time to lock it in. Two paths we typically offer — pick one and I'll set up the calendar: 

1) 30-minute product intro (recommended for execs + PMs) — high-level flow, UX, pricing buckets, quick Q&A.
2) 60-minute technical deep dive (recommended if infra / security / ML leads want hands-on details) — architecture, latency benchmarks, deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private), and integration checklist review.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Jun 16 — 10:00–10:30 (30-min intro)
- Wed Jun 17 — 14:00–14:30 (30-min intro)
- Wed Jun 17 — 15:00–16:00 (60-min technical deep dive)

I attached the discovery notes and a short integration checklist to help you decide. If you prefer a remote runbook-first approach, we can do a short call to validate the checklist before the deep dive.

Please reply with which path you prefer, who from your side will join, and which slot works best. I can also send an alternate 60-min slot next week if these don't fit.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
